procedure_name: Water & Sewerage Charge Waiver for Vacant Property
summary: Suspension of monthly minimum consumption and sewerage charges for unoccupied residential properties.

steps.title: Ensure electricity meter disconnection / zero usage
steps.description: Provide electricity bills showing zero power units consumed during the vacant period.

steps.title: Apply for vacant status endorsement
steps.description: Submit sworn affidavit from homeowner affirming that property remains locked and uninhabited.

steps.title: Inspection by meter reader
steps.description: Meter reader visits house to confirm locked status and record final dial reading.

steps.title: Approval of billing suspension
steps.description: Executive Engineer endorses vacant status, pausing recurring fixed sewage and meter charges.
